name: Peanut butter
summary: Peanut butter is ground roasted peanuts, sold smooth or crunchy and often with added salt or sugar. This page lists what people say peanut butter does; each claim can be checked against the research when you choose.
inIt: The UK food table (CoFID) measures smooth peanut butter at 607 kcal, 22.8 g of protein, 51.8 g of fat (12.8 g of it saturated), 6.7 g of sugars, 6.6 g of fibre, 350 mg of sodium, 180 mg of magnesium, 5.0 mg of vitamin E and 17.4 mg of niacin per 100 g. It does not measure the plant compounds in peanuts.
Peanuts are legumes, but they have a nut-like oil: a 2004 study of peanuts and tree nuts found a fat profile high in oleic and linoleic acid, plus tocopherols, squalene and plant sterols in the oil.
processing: Raw peanuts and peanut-based products can be contaminated with aflatoxins, poisons made by moulds that grow when peanuts are stored badly; a 2019 review followed their occurrence in raw peanuts and peanut-based products along the supply chain, from farm to table.
Shop peanut butter can carry added salt: the table's smooth entry has 350 mg of sodium per 100 g, while the same table's plain unsalted peanuts have 2 mg.

whoShouldBeCareful.note: The 2015 LEAP trial notes that peanut allergy in Western countries has doubled in the past 10 years and is becoming apparent in Africa and Asia. Peanut butter is a concentrated way to meet peanut protein, so people with a known or suspected peanut allergy can react to it. If you have a peanut allergy, or a baby with severe eczema or egg allergy, talk to your doctor or an allergist before peanut butter.

unknowns: Whether eating peanut butter changes long-term health beyond what cohort studies suggest: in the Nurses’ Health Study, higher peanut butter intake went with lower risk of type 2 diabetes, but such studies cannot show cause.
How much aflatoxin a given jar holds: it varies with supply chain and storage, and this page has no measured figure for any brand.
Whether the ancient Greeks or Romans knew peanuts: peanuts come from South America, and this page found no older written source that could be opened and read.
